category: in-memory key-value (data structures, Query Engine, JSON)
notes: Redis Open Source 8 (RediSearch/JSON/TimeSeries/probabilistic modules built in). Async primary->replica replication with diskless sync, AOF everysec on both; 3 Sentinels (quorum 2, down-after 2 s) elect a new primary; HAProxy round-robins reads over primary+replica. Documents are hashes with application-maintained index sets/zsets; FT.CREATE on products for text + vector.

strategy.server_log: plain text on stdout (`pid:role date level message`), loglevel notice; the docker json-file driver rotates it
strategy.slow_query: SLOWLOG (in-memory ring: slowlog-log-slower-than µs, slowlog-max-len) + LATENCY MONITOR (latency-monitor-threshold ms) + LATENCY DOCTOR
strategy.audit: ACL LOG for denied AUTH / NOPERM attempts (in memory, acllog-max-len); MONITOR is a live debug stream, not a log; persistent audit is Redis Enterprise
strategy.runtime: CONFIG SET loglevel / slowlog-* / latency-monitor-threshold apply immediately (CONFIG REWRITE persists them)
